name: get_observations
description: Time-series observations for one or more Bank of Canada series. Pass comma-separated series names. Well-known: FXUSDCAD (USD/CAD daily avg rate), FXEURCAD (EUR/CAD), V39079 (target for the overnight rate / policy rate), V41690973 (Total CPI). Choose either recent=N latest points OR a start_date/end_date window.

recent.description: Return the N most recent observations. Ignored if start_date is given.

end_date.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (optional, defaults to latest).

name: get_group_observations
description: Observations for every series in a named group in one call. Useful groups: FX_RATES_DAILY (daily exchange rates for all currencies vs CAD). Use recent=N or a start_date/end_date window.

recent.description: Return the N most recent observations. Ignored if start_date is given.

name: series_info
description: Metadata for a single series: label and description. e.g. "FXUSDCAD" or "V39079".

name: list_series
description: Discover available series. Optionally filter by a case-insensitive substring matched against series label/description, e.g. "exchange rate" or "CPI". Omit query to list all (large).

name: list_groups
description: Discover available series groups. Optionally filter by a case-insensitive substring matched against group label/description, e.g. "exchange" or "lending".
